reason: The agent gave the wrong free-cancellation cutoff. The policy says cancellations are free up to 2 hours before the booking, but the agent said 30 minutes before.
name: Cancellation cutoff

spec.goal: Find out until when a booking can be canceled without paying.
spec.behavior: You are polite and concise. Say you already have a booking and ask the cancellation question in one sentence. If they answer with a time, repeat it back once and end the call.
spec.policy_under_test: Cancellations are free only up to 2 hours before the booking.
spec.expected_outcome: The agent says the booking can be canceled for free up to 2 hours before the booked time.
